scope: Regional connections from Vancouver to Mission/Abbotsford; east bound extends to -122.2 to include every West Coast Express station and the five Lower Mainland road border crossings. Airport registry query uses the commercial bounds ending at -122.35.

coverage.SkyTrain station: Every station name in the official current TransLink station layer, merging separate line/platform records at interchanges.
coverage.Passenger rail: All eight West Coast Express station records, three VIA stations in the regional scope, and Vancouver Rocky Mountaineer terminal. Request stops and seasonal tourism service are labelled.
coverage.Border crossing: All five Lower Mainland public road crossings. Inspection lanes, schedules, eligibility and live waits are not represented.
coverage.Airport: All airport, aerodrome and water-aerodrome records in the stated BC registry bounds plus Vancouver Harbour public heliport. Registry entries do not establish public access, current operation or passenger flight schedules.
coverage.Ferry terminal: All two SeaBus station records and three BC Ferries connections in the TransLink map; this does not inventory every local water taxi or private ferry.

limitations: Downloaded static inventory, not live transit, aviation or border operating information.
Airport registry source years are often 2014 even when the registry update is newer. Older references are displayed and retained; no current-open verification is claimed.
Point geometry is not entrance or route validation. See individual LOCATION_BASIS fields.
Municipal/local heritage tourist rail and private charter pickup locations are not a complete inventory.
